evidence.reason: `DEPENDENCY_RE` enumerates `[Unit]` relationship directives but omits `StopPropagatedFrom=` and `PropagatesStopTo=`. The surrounding comment says the dependency scan must read every loadable unit type because a co-installed unit can affect the selected unit. A foreign `ingress.service` with `StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service` therefore escapes the scan, and when the fence stops `crq-tick.service`, systemd also stops `ingress.service`. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency scan, not a request for new scope.
